title: Iterating an adjoint tensor comparison through flat coefficients
statement: Let A,T,E,D be commutative rings, f:A→T, c:T→E, d:T→D, k:E→D ring maps with k∘c=d and k flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. For a complex Q of A-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], put X=T⊗_A Q, XE=E⊗_A Q and XD=D⊗_A Q using these composites [def-weil-module-base-change]. Let S,N be T-modules, s:S≅N, a:S→H^i(X), b:N→H^i(X) with s followed by b equal to a. Let vE:X→c_*XE and vD:X→d_*XD send t⊗q to c(t)⊗q and d(t)⊗q. Let aE:E⊗_T S→H^i(XE) and aD:D⊗_T N→H^i(XD) be the adjoint transposes of H(vE)∘a and H(vD)∘b under exact restriction homology. Put F=extension along k. Suppose e:F(E⊗_T S)≅D⊗_T N sends 1⊗(1⊗x) to 1⊗s(x). For every chain iso tau:F(XE)≅XD sending 1⊗(1⊗q) to 1⊗q, F(aE) followed by inverse exact F-homology and H^i(tau) equals e followed by aD.

proof.text: Flatness of k makes extension F exact, hence gives mapHomologyIso F on XE. Restriction along c,d,k is exact.

Construct the adjunct chain map v of tau. ShortComplex.LeftHomologyMapData, with unit naturality on cycles and opcycles, proves that its homology map is the adjunct of inverse exact homology comparison followed by H(tau). Prove cycles and homology comparison composition for arbitrary categories with zero morphisms and zero-preserving homology-preserving functors F, G and their composite. For arbitrary left homology data h, the iterated and composite inclusions and projections agree; cancel their monic inclusion and epic homology projection to identify both canonical comparisons. Expanding the comparison isomorphisms with h and h.map F cancels the intermediate isomorphism after applying G. Specialize the homology composition identity at the forgetAdjunct call site to restriction of scalars followed by forgetting to abelian groups; naturality then rewrites each given adjunct equation. Tensor induction proves that vE followed by v after forgetting equals vD: on t tensor q use scalar linearity and k(c(t))=d(t). Apply homology, substitute s followed by b equals a, and use the nested-generator equation of e. Cancel the forgetful homology isomorphism, transpose through k, and use ExtendScalars.hom_ext through c to conclude. All steps and private helpers are proved in Lean from Mathlib.

theorem flatIteratedScalarExtension_homology_square
    (A T E D : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing T] [CommRing E] [CommRing D]
    (f : A →+* T) (c : T →+* E) (d : T →+* D) (k : E →+* D)
    (hk : k.Flat) (hcomp : k.comp c = d)
    (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (i : ℤ) :
    let X := ((extendScalars f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q
    let XE := ((extendScalars (c.comp f)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q
    let XD := ((extendScalars (d.comp f)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q
    let F := extendScalars k
    letI := preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat hk
    ∀ (S N : ModuleCat.{u} T) (s : S ≅ N)
      (a : S ⟶ X.homology i) (b : N ⟶ X.homology i),
      s.hom ≫ b = a →
      ∀ (vE : X ⟶ ((restrictScalars c).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj XE)
        (vD : X ⟶ ((restrictScalars d).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj XD),
      (∀ (j : ℤ) (t : T) (q : Q.X j),
        vE.f j (t ⊗ₜ[A, f] q) = c t ⊗ₜ[A, c.comp f] q) →
      (∀ (j : ℤ) (t : T) (q : Q.X j),
        vD.f j (t ⊗ₜ[A, f] q) = d t ⊗ₜ[A, d.comp f] q) →
      ∀ (aE : (extendScalars c).obj S ⟶ XE.homology i)
        (aD : (extendScalars d).obj N ⟶ XD.homology i),
      (extendRestrictScalarsAdj c).unit.app S ≫ (restrictScalars c).map aE =
        a ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap vE i ≫
          ((XE.sc i).mapHomologyIso (restrictScalars c)).hom →
      (extendRestrictScalarsAdj d).unit.app N ≫ (restrictScalars d).map aD =
        b ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap vD i ≫
          ((XD.sc i).mapHomologyIso (restrictScalars d)).hom →
      ∀ (e : F.obj ((extendScalars c).obj S) ≅ (extendScalars d).obj N),
      (∀ x : S, e.hom ((1 : D) ⊗ₜ[E, k] ((1 : E) ⊗ₜ[T, c] x)) =
        (1 : D) ⊗ₜ[T, d] (s.hom x)) →
      ∀ tau : (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj XE ≅ XD,
      (∀ (j : ℤ) (x : Q.X j),
        tau.hom.f j ((1 : D) ⊗ₜ[E, k] ((1 : E) ⊗ₜ[A, c.comp f] x)) =
          (1 : D) ⊗ₜ[A, d.comp f] x) →
      F.map aE ≫ ((XE.sc i).mapHomologyIso F).inv ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap tau.hom i = e.hom ≫ aD
